cohort: 201 women who gave birth vaginally at term to a singleton infant with an Apgar score >7 at 5 minutes
finding: Intrapartum oxytocin administration was associated with impaired breastfeeding in the first hour after birth, but this association was not significant at 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Intrapartum oxytocin administration was associated with impaired breastfeeding in the first hour after birth.
